role: Gate: replays the oracle's EntityProbe dump (shapes, item entity and XP orb spawns from Random(opseed) and Det OTHER streams, 1200 ticks) through csrc/engine/item_entity.c and compares position, motion, onGround, age, delay, fire, stack, removals and Det digests after every tick.

structs.name: splitref
structs.java: one Det split stream (determinize.sh static RNG name) per role

structs.name: ref
structs.java: the oracle's Det start.txt/end.txt snapshot (netherite.oracle.Det: world seed, per-role nextId, seeder/math digests, split streams)

structs.name: spawn_rec
structs.java: one spawns.bin record (position, item id, damage, count or XP value)

structs.name: tick_rec
structs.java: one per-entity per-tick state record from ticks.bin.gz

notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/items. Native calls: ie_init, ie_spawn_item, ie_spawn_orb, ie_added_to_world, ie_tick, ie_free (csrc/engine/item_entity.h), aabb_expand, world_*, det_*, jr_*. Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/EntityProbe.java. Recordings: out/java/items/ent-2, ent-42. spawn_rec/tick_rec field lists abbreviated.
